// _NOTE: Production secrets MUST come from environment variables. The values here are local-development fallbacks only and must never be committed with real credentials.

ConnectionStrings.// _DefaultConnection: Local-dev fallback. Production reads DATABASE_URL env var (Render-style postgres:// URI is parsed automatically in Program.cs).

Jwt.// _Key: Production reads JWT_KEY env var. Local fallback below is NOT a secret.

Email.// _NOTE: Production reads SMTP_* env vars (see OutlookEmailSender). Leave blank locally to disable.

Cloudinary.// _NOTE: Production reads CLOUDINARY_URL env var (format: cloudinary://api_key:api_secret@cloud_name). Empty here so local dev falls back to disk storage.
